name: Ceiling-suspended AC units
tagline: Wide air throw with no false ceiling needed
description: Under-ceiling units that hang directly from the slab and spread air across wide, open spaces.
long_description: Ceiling-suspended (also called floor-ceiling or under-ceiling) units mount flat against the ceiling, or low on a wall, and throw air horizontally across the room. They give cassette-like coverage without a false ceiling, which makes them a good fit for exposed-slab interiors, older buildings, restaurants and workshops.
use_case: Restaurants, showrooms and halls without false ceilings
features: Long horizontal air throw for wide rooms
Easy access for filter cleaning and servicing

specs.label: Power supply
specs.value: Single phase up to ~2 TR; three phase for larger models

considerations: The unit stays visible, so plan its placement with the interior design
Mount it on the long wall side so air throws across the room
Ideal where ceilings can't be lowered or opened

faqs.question: Ceiling-suspended or cassette?
faqs.answer: Choose a cassette if you have a false ceiling and want a flush look. Choose ceiling-suspended where there's no false ceiling or you need longer air throw.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for kitchens?
faqs.answer: For dining areas, yes. Commercial kitchens need extra filtration and regular coil cleaning because of grease.
